# CarHub

> CarHub is a car-rental platform for browsing vehicles, comparing rental prices, and finding car details.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://carhub-rent.vercel.app/): Featured and recommended cars.
- [Categories](https://carhub-rent.vercel.app/categories): Browse and filter cars by make, type, fuel, transmission, and price.
- [Contact](https://carhub-rent.vercel.app/contact): Contact information and inquiry form.
- [Favorites](https://carhub-rent.vercel.app/favorites): View saved cars in the current browser.

## Car details

- Car detail pages use the URL pattern `https://carhub-rent.vercel.app/cars/{carId}`.
- Each detail page includes vehicle specifications, images, rental pricing, and reviews.
- Some actions, including checkout and posting reviews, require an account.

## Notes

- Vehicle listings and details are provided by the CarHub application API and may change.
- Do not assume prices, availability, ratings, or review content are fixed.
